previous_assumption: no plan existed for where a public, session-agnostic invite-acceptance page would live in the Next.js route structure
correction: Created app/invite/[token]/page.tsx OUTSIDE both the (app) and (public) route groups, since (app)'s layout force-redirects unauthenticated visitors to /login and (public)'s layout force-redirects authenticated ones to / — this page must render correctly in both states at once (an existing user accepting into a second org, or a brand-new visitor signing up on the spot). SessionProvider lives in the root layout so useSession() still works here with no extra wiring.
